section.title: Introduction and Overview
section.p: The sprite plot action is a bit field allowing the caller to specify the manner of the sprite plotting. It is used on a number of OS_SpriteOp calls, in particular :

section.title: Technical Details
section.p: The following bits are used within the plot action :

bitfield-table.bit:
Plot action (see PRM 1-753):
Overwrite OR AND EOR Invert No-effect AND-NOT OR-NOT
Use mask if set, otherwise ignore mask data if present. See PRM 1-753
Use palette entries rather than translation table if suitable. See PRM 5a-117
Wide Translation Table has been used if set, otherwise 8 bit translation is present. See PRM 5a-118
Use dithering to more accurately match colours if set, otherwise the fastest rendering method will be used. See PRM 5a-118
Colour-mapping function is provided rather than a translation table if set. See

Translucency level (see ):
Solid image No effect, or close to no effect Other values linearly represent translucency levels between these extremes, but may be quantised by the rendering implementation in SpriteExtend or other acceleration systems
